title: The affine etale site of a limit of schemes is the colimit of the affine etale sites
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set and $(X_i,f_{i'i})$ an inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme] over $I$ with affine transition morphisms [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], with limit $X=\varprojlim X_i$ and projections $f_i:X\to X_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. For $i'\ge i$ let $u_{i'i}:(X_i)_{affine,\Et}\to(X_{i'})_{affine,\Et}$ and $u_i:(X_i)_{affine,\Et}\to X_{affine,\Et}$ be the base change functors $V\mapsto V\times_{X_i}X_{i'}$, $V\mapsto V\times_{X_i}X$ on the small affine etale sites of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-site-topos] (the base changes are affine because $f_{i'i}$ and $f_i$ are affine, and etale). Then the $u_{i'i}$ are continuous and define morphisms of sites $(X_{i'})_{affine,\Et}\to(X_i)_{affine,\Et}$, so that $((X_i)_{affine,\Et})$ with the cofiltered index category $I^{\mathrm{op}}$ is a system as in [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-of-sites] (standard etale coverings are finite), and the functor $\varinjlim_i(X_i)_{affine,\Et}\to X_{affine,\Et}$ induced by the $u_i$ is an isomorphism of sites in the sense of [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-of-sites]: it is an equivalence of categories, every affine $U$ etale over $X$ is $U_i\times_{X_i}X$ for some $i$ and some affine $U_i$ etale over $X_i$, morphisms over $X$ between such base changes come from morphisms over some $X_{i'}$, two morphisms over $X_{i}$ that agree over $X$ agree over some $X_{i'}$, and the coverings of $X_{affine,\Et}$ are exactly the images of the standard etale coverings of the $(X_i)_{affine,\Et}$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0EYL (lemma-colimit-affine-sites, line 7336) and its proof, which uses Limits Lemmas Tag 01ZM (descend-finite-presentation), Tag 01Z6 (limit-affine), Tag 07RP (descend-etale), Tag 07RR (descend-surjective), Tag 0EY1 (descend-finite-presentation-variant); the colimit of sites is Sites Lemma Tag 09YL
